definition.name: [Palo Alto Networks Firewall] Critical threat detected but not blocked on {{@device_name.name}}

description: Alerts when a firewall logs a critical-severity threat whose action is `alert`: the threat was detected but not blocked, usually because a security profile is set to alert only or an exception applies. Blocked critical threats (drop, reset, block and similar actions) are intentionally excluded, since the firewall already stopped them; their volume is on the dashboard. Requires Palo Alto Networks Firewall log collection.
title: Critical threat detected but not blocked
